Its Contract omitted docs/reference/capability-truth-matrix.json; Preflight and fast checks were ready/pass, then the expensive project-test reported stale evidence. The existing byte gate was correct; the missing reusable control was dependency discovery before edits and against the actual diff.

Task 1 review finding and fix: an empty capabilities inventory could otherwise be treated as a configured but harmless dependency graph. scripts/ai_evidence_dependencies.py now rejects a configured matrix unless capabilities is a non-empty list, preserving fail-closed behavior; tests/test_evidence_dependencies.py covers the invalid inventory.

The first full quality run reached 1478 passed but 34 installer/adoption tests failed and five Japanese lifecycle tests errored because installed ai_preflight_review.py and ai_check_scope.py imported ai_evidence_dependencies.py while the authoritative installer catalog omitted that module. A RED installed-runtime assertion reproduced the missing payload; the catalog now distributes the module, Capability Truth bytes were regenerated, and the six-file focused suite passes 120 tests.

The corrected full quality gate passed 1517 tests in 354.56 seconds, then ai-finish rejected the Summary's unsupported verificationEvidence field and missing acceptanceEvidence. Because ai-finish does not reuse a still-valid passed quality result after a Summary-only correction, canonical completion requires repeating the heavy gate. Preserve this as input to the later workflow/process corrective; do not bypass ai-finish in this Work Item.
